source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: When driving unsupervised on a Level Two license you may carry one passenger under twenty one who does not live in your household plus one other such passenger going directly to or from school and there is no under twenty one limit when all passengers live in your household.
corrections.note: Added the school trip second passenger and household exception omitted by the statement.

corrections.corrected_statement: When driving unsupervised on a Level Two license there is no under twenty one limit if all passengers live in your household but under twenty one household members may not ride together with under twenty one non household members.
corrections.note: Added the missing when driving unsupervised condition to the mixed passenger ban.

corrections.corrected_statement: On a Level Two license you may drive without supervision from five in the morning until nine in the evening and at any time when driving directly to or from work or volunteer fire rescue or emergency medical service if you are a member.
corrections.note: Removed the unsupported first level claim and added the member condition.

corrections.corrected_statement: You must hold a Level Two license for at least six months before applying for a Full Provisional License.
corrections.note: Removed the nine month Level One comparison not stated on this page.

corrections.corrected_statement: Under Lose Control Lose Your License you lose your license if you receive a suspension for more than ten consecutive days or an assignment to an alternative educational setting for more than ten consecutive days due to disciplinary action.
corrections.note: Removed the unsupported claim that traffic violations are excluded.

corrections.corrected_statement: If your license is restricted you must only drive within the limits of the restriction otherwise you are considered to be driving without a license.
corrections.note: Removed the unsupported not a minor infraction characterization.

corrections.corrected_statement: Civilian renewal by mail requires living outside North Carolina for at least thirty continuous days plus a permanent verifiable North Carolina residence address and a Class C license expired no more than two years and a photo on file from the last five years and a Social Security number or legal presence record on file and a vision statement signed by a licensed physician and a signed sex offender affidavit and age no older than seventy two and renewal by mail only every other cycle.
corrections.note: Added the missing Social Security number or legal presence record and other page requirements.

corrections.corrected_statement: Civilian renewal by mail requires a DMV photo from the last five years, while the military version allows a photo up to eight years old.
corrections.note: The eight year military photo rule is stated on page 29, not page 28.

corrections.corrected_statement: A license lasts eight years if issued at age eighteen through sixty five and five years if issued at age sixty six or older, expiring on the birthday.
corrections.note: Removed the knowledge test date claim which no provided page states.

corrections.corrected_statement: A driver younger than twenty one years old who is convicted of driving with any amount of alcohol or drugs in the body will have the license revoked for one year.
corrections.note: Removed the adult per se comparison not stated on the provided pages.

corrections.corrected_statement: When your driving privilege is reinstated all previous driver license points are canceled but this does not pertain to insurance points.
corrections.note: Removed the added claim about insurers keeping their own point system.

corrections.corrected_statement: The two-second rule governs the gap to the car ahead, while seeing farther ahead is what you need as speed rises, because stopping distance grows.
corrections.note: The stopping-distance-grows part is stated on page 54, not page 55.

corrections.corrected_statement: When passing, signal your intention and blow the horn to alert the driver ahead, and when you are being passed you must help the other driver pass by moving to the right edge of the road if the horn is blown and never increasing your speed.
corrections.note: Added that moving right is required only if the passing driver blows the horn.

corrections.corrected_statement: Because bicyclists ride to the right of cars, a cyclist going straight through an intersection is at risk from a motorist turning right.
Pedestrians walk on the left facing traffic, which is the opposite of the ride-with-traffic rule for bicyclists.
A learner permit holder must be accompanied while driving by a person licensed to operate that vehicle who is seated beside the permit holder.
corrections.note: Removed driving alone claim because no provided page states it.

corrections.corrected_statement: Regular license classes and commercial license classes share the letters A, B and C, but a regular Class C is the ordinary noncommercial license that most car and small-truck drivers need.
corrections.note: Commercial Class A, B and C list appears on page 13, not page 12.

corrections.corrected_statement: Shape and color make it possible to recognize kinds of highway signs at a glance and traffic signs include regulatory signs such as the eight sided stop sign.
corrections.note: Narrowed to what page eighty five states, removing warning and guide names found on later pages.

corrections.corrected_statement: The five sided pentagon sign warns of a school zone or a school crossing and drivers should watch especially for children in these areas.
corrections.note: Removed stop octagon and yield triangle comparison not stated on the cited page.
